summary: InMode Ltd. filed a 6-K disclosing its receipt of an unsolicited going-private proposal from M.N. Business Strategy, Ltd., a group including CEO Moshe Mizrahy, to acquire all outstanding ordinary shares for $16.20 per share in cash. The board formed a special committee of independent directors to evaluate the proposal. The consideration is all cash, with no premium stated versus prior close. Advisors are not yet named. The transaction would take the company private; no regulatory timeline provided. Watch for competing bids, committee's fairness opinion, and any special committee recommendation. Risk-arb spread will hinge on likelihood of a superior offer or negotiation.
